changelog: - **Auto-play pauses when the desalination example's plant first stops.** When one of its five water-path stages stops because what it needs runs short or a tank downstream is full, Play pauses once and the run row says which stage stopped, at which step and which tank; played on, it does not pause again in that run, and the later stops stay in the run notices. Past the 90 days the example is checked over, the run row says so while the model is the example's, and an edit to the model removes the note. The analysis area's least height counts the new line, so the chart and its first strip stay whole.
